input.context: The crew:parallel-runner agent has been proposed for the guard-feat-dispatch allowlist. The allowlist controls which agents may dispatch on FEAT work. parallel-runner calls crew:build per worktree and produces its own artifact trail. However, FEAT-136 just shipped Path A: the /crew:parallel skill dispatches crew:build per worktree directly, making crew:parallel-runner redundant on the FEAT path. Write a decision record.
constraints: Decision must record all three evaluation criteria from FEAT-137 AC-2
Must explain why Path A (DEC-015) removes the pain point
Allowlist must remain documented and not ambiguous
Document must be durable — a new contributor 12 months from now should understand the decision without reading FEAT-136

expected_output.summary: ADR-001: Do NOT add crew:parallel-runner to guard-feat-dispatch allowlist. Path A (DEC-015) renders it unnecessary. Narrower allowlist reduces indirect dispatch chains and maintains observability at the leaf level.
expected_output.non_goals_explicit: Does not retire parallel-runner (it remains available for non-FEAT batch work); does not change the allowlist for the three approved criteria
failure_modes_named: Contributor adds parallel-runner to allowlist without reading ADR — allowlist comment would suppress the question; ADR provides the permanent anchor
Path A is reverted — if crew:parallel no longer dispatches crew:build per worktree, ADR-001 must be revisited (superseded_by field)

adr_001.related: DEC-015 (FEAT-136), FEAT-137 AC-2, agents/parallel-runner.md scope note

expected_output.test_strategy_present: No runtime test; structural: validate-agents.ts confirms parallel-runner.md scope note references ADR-001; CI gate guards allowlist list format
expected_output.tradeoffs_articulated: Path B (allowlist): permits indirect dispatch chains (parallel-runner → dispatcher) — reduces observability of leaf context. Path A (not allowlisted): direct crew:build per worktree is already allowlisted; no added complexity. Path A is strictly better when available.

notes: Directly mined from ADR-001 (docs/architecture/decisions/ADR-001-parallel-runner-allowlist.md). Held-out case 1 of 2. Seed type: adr_draft.
